The "..." menu is open on the first post in the Following feed (the whiskers "Mochi napping in a sunbeam" post). It shows Translate, Copy post text, Assign topic for algo, Mute thread, Mute words & tags, Hide post for me, Mute account, Block account, and Report post.

There is no tap tool here, so I sent the tap through an XCUITest runner built with `xcodegen` and `xcodebuild`. Bluesky's accessibility tree wouldn't snapshot, so I aimed the tap at SpringBoard's full-screen coordinates, which worked. The test project is in `bench-tmp-r98_sous/tapper`. I also terminated and relaunched Bluesky during debugging, so the app is running fresh.
